label: D1 update gate high after reaching S2 (esp. rare a1->S2), low after S1
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u")
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 19 is near 0 at GO and D2 and active only at D1. Its D1 magnitude is set by the state reached on the previous trial: high (~0.9-0.98) after S2, near 0 after S1. Within S2, it is highest when S2 was reached via a1 (rare transition) and somewhat lower after a2->S2 (common), more so if that trial was rewarded. Reward alone, the trial before, the hidden good state, time since reversal and episode decile add essentially nothing (adding tv state -2 and ep_dec interaction raised dev R^2 only 0.791->0.793). Four observed-only D1 terms give dev R^2 beyond timing 0.79, matching the last-trial reference (0.79) and close to the all ceiling (0.83).

issues: Small overclaim: the explanation says z is 'about 0.9 to 0.98' after S2, but that only holds for a1->S2 (rare). Timing baseline plus residual puts D1 after a2 S2 r at about 0.39+0.28=0.67 and after a2 S2 u at about 0.39+0.36=0.75. The explanation does go on to say a2->S2 is lower, so the conclusion holds, but the stated range is too high for the common-S2 case.

For a1->S2, reward makes almost no difference (residuals: a1 S2 r +0.548, a1 S2 u +0.561). The 'lower if rewarded' effect only shows up for a2->S2 (+0.28 vs +0.36), and the label states it correctly only for that case.

Within the a2->S2 cell there is leftover variance: z is about 0.94 when the previous trial was a switch from a1 and about 0.65-0.77 when a2 was repeated (worst-fit windows). Terms for that (trial-2 action, stay, trial-2 state, trial-2 reward) each add only about 0.002-0.004 test R^2, so it is not a large systematic gap.

Many of the worst misses are windows where the first trial's previous trial lies outside the window (prev_state = -1, D1 actual 0.94 vs predicted 0.36). That is a data artifact, not something the explanation leaves out. A prev_state==-1 term adds nothing (0.7898).

Misses by phase show no systematic error: mean errors are D1 -0.002, GO +0.001, D2 +0.001, and the largest cell error is 0.018 (GO after a1 S2 r). Continuous add-ons (value, choice logit, ep_trial times prev_state==2) reach at most 0.796 test R^2.
